description.en:
The credential name. Valid values:

- 01: personal card or certificate
  - 0101: ID card
  - 0102: bank card
  - 0104: teacher qualification certificate
  - 0107: student ID card
- 02: business scenario
  - 0201: storefront photo
  - 0202: counter photo
  - 0203: scene photo
- 03: enterprise qualification
  - 0301: business license.

descriptions.zh: 传入凭证图片信息，执行图片篡改及伪造检测、图片语义理解。返回风险检测结果。
descriptions.en: Submits a credential image to perform image tampering and forgery detection and image semantic understanding. Returns risk detection results.
